exito.formularioCreado: The form was created as a Draft. Now add its questions.

estado.cerrarMensaje: It will stop receiving answers. It cannot return to Draft or Published.

acceso.denegado: Access denied: only a user with the Researcher role can create, edit or delete.

general.inesperado: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
